                The IB moved to a new EE guide for first assessment May 2027, with different criteria than the guide used since 2018. Pick the one that matches your exam session below. One criterion in each guide (Engagement, or Reflection in the new guide) is graded from a separate reflection statement rather than the essay text — paste yours below to get it assessed too, or leave it blank to skip it. Everything here is an AI estimate to help you revise, not an official IB mark.

                The 2027-guide criteria here are compiled from published secondary summaries, since ibo.org blocks automated access — if anything here conflicts with what your EE coordinator or the official subject guide says, trust them over this tool.
